findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy
findings.detail: A CSP limits what scripts and resources the page may load, which blunts cross-site scripting attacks.
findings.fix: Start with a report-only policy, then enforce one that lists the sources you really use.

findings.title: The page can be embedded in other sites
findings.detail: Without X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors, attackers can frame your pages to trick visitors into clicking (clickjacking).
findings.fix: Send X-Frame-Options: DENY or CSP frame-ancestors 'self'.

findings.title: Page content only appears after JavaScript runs
findings.detail: The raw HTML holds about 61 characters of text, but the loaded page shows 2722. Search engines, link previews and slow devices may see an empty page.
findings.fix: Pre-render or server-render the key content so it is present in the first HTML response.

findings.title: 2 oversized images
findings.detail: Images over 300 KB slow down the first view.
findings.fix: Resize to the displayed size and serve WebP or AVIF.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
findings.detail: Browsers may guess file types and execute content that should not run.

findings.title: No Referrer-Policy
findings.detail: Full page addresses, which can contain private data, may be sent to other sites you link to.

findings.title: The www version of the domain has a certificate problem
findings.detail: https://www.qualaces.com fails its certificate check (ERR_TLS_CERT_ALTNAME_INVALID). Anyone who types the www address sees a browser warning.
findings.fix: Add the www name to the certificate, or redirect it to the main domain over a valid certificate.

findings.title: Incomplete social sharing tags
findings.detail: Links shared on social networks and chat apps will show a bare or wrong preview.

findings.title: Alternative text of images should not be repeated as text (4 elements)
findings.detail: Ensure image alternative is not repeated as text

findings.title: No Permissions-Policy
findings.detail: You cannot restrict powerful browser features (camera, microphone, location) for the page and any embeds.
findings.fix: Send a Permissions-Policy that disables features you do not use.

narrative.executiveSummary: qualaces.com scores 87 out of 100. Its strongest area is reliability (100) and its weakest is security (68). The audit found 1 high, 3 medium, 6 low issues. The best place to start is security testing, followed by usability testing.
actions: Images must have alternative text (8 elements)
The page can be embedded in other sites

limitations: One page is measured in depth (plus a small sample of its links). Other pages can behave differently.
Only Chromium is used, so cross-browser and real-device behaviour is not measured.
Checks are passive: the audit loads the page like a visitor and reads public headers. It is not a penetration test.
Performance numbers come from one run from one location and will vary with your hosting, network and time of day.
Automated accessibility scanning finds roughly a third of real-world issues. Manual testing is still needed.
